title: Alert Validation Dashboard
description: Dashboard to validate active alert rules by visualizing the same PromQL expressions used in alert_management.py. Covers latency (P50/P99), error rates (4xx/5xx/overall), and system resource metrics (CPU/memory/disk).

panels.title: Overall P50 Latency
panels.description: Median (50th percentile) request latency across all inference endpoints, filtered by tenant. Matches the application/latency PromQL in alert_management.py.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, endpoint, tenant) (rate(telemetry_obsv_request_duration_seconds_bucket{endpoint=~"/.*inference.*", tenant=~"$tenant"}[5m])))

panels.title: 4xx Error Rate
panels.description: Client error rate (4xx) as percentage of total requests on inference endpoints. Uses telemetry_obsv_requests_total{status_code=~"4.."} matching alert_management.py pattern.

targets.expr: 100 * (sum by (endpoint, tenant)(rate(telemetry_obsv_requests_total{status_code=~"4..", endpoint=~"/.*inference.*", tenant=~"$tenant"}[5m])) / sum by (endpoint, tenant)(rate(telemetry_obsv_requests_total{endpoint=~"/.*inference.*", tenant=~"$tenant"}[5m])))

panels.title: 5xx Error Rate
panels.description: Server error rate (5xx) as percentage of total requests on inference endpoints. Uses telemetry_obsv_requests_total{status_code=~"5.."} matching alert_management.py pattern.

targets.expr: 100 * (sum by (endpoint, tenant)(rate(telemetry_obsv_requests_total{status_code=~"5..", endpoint=~"/.*inference.*", tenant=~"$tenant"}[5m])) / sum by (endpoint, tenant)(rate(telemetry_obsv_requests_total{endpoint=~"/.*inference.*", tenant=~"$tenant"}[5m])))

panels.title: Overall Error Rate

targets.expr: 100 * (sum by (endpoint, tenant)(rate(telemetry_obsv_requests_total{status_code!~"200|201", endpoint=~"/.*inference.*", tenant=~"$tenant"}[5m])) / sum by (endpoint, tenant)(rate(telemetry_obsv_requests_total{endpoint=~"/.*inference.*", tenant=~"$tenant"}[5m])))

panels.title: CPU Usage
panels.description: Current CPU utilization. Matches alert_management.py infrastructure/cpu expression exactly: 100 * (1 - idle/total).

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - (sum(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[5m])) / sum(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total[5m]))))

panels.title: Memory Usage
panels.description: Current memory usage. Matches alert_management.py infrastructure/memory expression exactly: max(100 * (1 - MemAvailable / MemTotal)).

targets.expr: max(100 * (1 - (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes)))

panels.title: Disk Usage
panels.description: Root filesystem disk usage. Matches alert_management.py infrastructure/disk expression exactly: max(100 * (1 - avail/size)) with fstype!~"tmpfs|ramfs|overlay".

targets.expr: max(100 * (1 - (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|ramfs|overlay", mountpoint="/"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|ramfs|overlay", mountpoint="/"})))
